verses: Boht ba-barkat hai woh Allah Taalaa jiss ney apney banday per furqan utara takay woh tamam logon kay liye aagah kerney wala bann jaye
Ussi Allah ki saltanat hai aasmano aur zamin ki aur woh koi aulad nahi rakhta, na uss ki saltanat mein koi uss ka sajhi hai aur her cheez ko uss ney peda kerkay aik munasib andaza thehra diya hai

Unn logon ney Allah kay siwa jinhen apney mabood thehra rakhay hain woh kissi cheez ko peda nahi saktay balkay)yeh woh khud peda kiye jatay hain, yeh to apni jaan kay nuksan nafa ka bhi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay aur na maut o hayat kay aur na doobara ji uthney kay woh malik hain
Aur kafiron ney kaha yeh to bus khud ussi ka ghara gharaya jhoot hai jiss per aur logon ney bhi uss ki madad ki hai, dar-asal yeh kafir baray hi zulm aur sir-ta-sir jhoot kay murtakib huye hain
Aur yeh bhi kaha kay yeh to aglon kay afsaney hain jo uss ney likha rakhay hain bus o hi subha o shaam uss kay samney parhay jatay hain
Keh dijiye kay ussay to uss Allah ney utara hai jo aasman o zamin ki tamam posheedah baaton ko janta hai. Be-shak woh bara hi bakhshney wala meharban hai

Aur unhon ney kaha kay yeh kaisa rasool hai? Kay khana khata hai aur bazaron mein chalta phirta hai, uss kay pass koi farishta kiyon nahi bheja jata? Kay woh bhi uss kay sath ho ker daraney wala bann jata
Ya uss kay pass koi khazana hi daal diya jata ya uss ka koi baagh hi hota jiss mein say yeh khata. Aur unn zalimon ney kaha kay tum aisay aadmi kay peechay ho liye ho jiss per jadoo ker diya gaya hai
Khayal to kijiye! kay yeh log aap ki nisbat kaisi kaisi baaten banatay hain. Pus jiss say woh khud hi behak rahey hain aur kissi tarah raah per nahi saktay

Allah Taalaa to aisa ba-barkat hai kay agar chahaye to aap ko boht say aisay baghaat inayat farma dey jo unn kay kahey huye baagh say boht hi behtar hun jin kay neechay nehren lehren ley rahi hun aur aap ko boht say (pukhta) mehal bhi dey dey
Baat yeh hai kay yeh log qayamat ko jhoot samajhtay hain aur qayamat kay jhutlanay walon kay liye hum ney bharakti hui aag tayyar ker rakhi hai
Jab woh unhen door say dekhay gi to yeh uss ka ghussay say bipharna aur dharna sunen gay
Aur jab yeh jahannum ki kissi tang jagah mein mashken kiss ker phenk diye jayen gay to o haan apney liye maut hi maut pukaren gay
(unn say kaha jaye ga) aaj aik hi maut ko na pukaro balkay)yeh boht si ammwaat ko pukaro
Aap keh dijiye kay kiya yeh behtar hai ya woh hameshgi wali jannat jiss ka wada perhezgaron say kiya gaya hai, jo unn ka badla hai aur unn kay lotney ki asli jagah hai
Woh jo chahayen gay unn kay liye o haan mojood hoga, hamesha rehney walay. Yeh to aap kay rab kay zimmay wada hai jo qabil talab hai
Aur jiss din Allah Taalaa unhen aur siwaye Allah kay jinhen yeh poojtay rahey, unhen jama kerkay poochay ga kay kiya meray unn bandon ko tum ney gumrah kiya ya yeh khud hi raah say gumm hogaye

Woh jawab den gay kay to pak zaat hai khud humen hi yeh zaiba na tha kay teray siwa auron ko apna kaarsaaz banatay baat yeh hai kay tu ney unhen aur unn kay baap dadon ko aasoodgiyan ata farmaeen yahan tak kay woh naseehat bhala bethay, yeh log thay hi halak honey walay

To unhon ney to tumhen tumhari tamam baaton mein jhutlaya, abb na to tum mein azabon kay pherney ki taqat hai, na madad kerney ki, tum mein say jiss jiss ney zulm kiya hai hum ussay bara azab chakhayen gay

Hum ney aap say pehlay jitney rasool bhejay sab kay sab khana bhi khatay thay aur bazaron mein bhi chaltay phirtay thay aur hum ney tum mein say her aik ko doosray ki aazmaeesh ka zariye bana diya. Kiya tum sabar kero gay? Tera rab sab kuch dekhney wala hai

Aur jinhen humari mulaqat ki tawaqqa nahi unhon ney kaha kay hum per farishtay kiyon nahi utaray jatay? Ya hum apni aankhon say apney rab ko dekh letay? Unn logon ney apney aap ko hi boht bara samajh rakha hai aur sakht sirkashi kerli hai
Jiss din yeh farishton ko dekh len gay uss din unn gunah gaaron ko koi khushi na hogi aur kahen gay yeh mehroom hi mehroom kiye gaye
Aur unhon ney jo jo aemaal kiye thay hum unn ki taraf barh ker unhen paragandah zarron ki tarah kerdiya
Albatta uss din jannatiyon ka thikana behtar hoga aur khuwab gaah bhi umdah hogi
Aur jiss din aasman badal samet phat jaye ga aur farishtay lagataar utaray jayen gay
Uss din sahih tor per mulk sirf rehman ka hi hoga aur yeh din kafiron per bara bhari hoga
Aur uss din zalim shakhs apney hathon ko chaba chaba ker kahey ga haaye kaash kay mein ney rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ki raah ikhtiyar ki hoti
Haaye afsos kaash kay mein ney falan ko dost na banaya hota
Uss ney to mujhay uss kay baad gumrah kerdiya kay naseehat meray pass phonchi thi aur shetan to insan ko (waqt per) dagha denay wala hai
Aur rasool kahey ga kay aey meray perwerdigar! be-shak meri ummat ney uss Quran ko chor rakha tha
Aur ussi tarah hum ney her nabi kay dushman baaz gunah gaaron ko banadiya hai aur tera rab hi hidayat kerney wala aur madad kerney wala kafi hai

Aur kafiron ney kaha kay uss per Quran sara ka sara aik sath hi kiyon na utara gaya ussi tarah hum ney (thora thora kerkay) utara takay uss say hum aap ka dil qavi rakhen, hum ney ussay thehar thehar ker hi parh sunaya hai
Yeh aap kay pass jo koi misal layen gay hum uss ka sacha jawab aur umdah tojeeh aap ko bata den gay
Jo log apney mun kay bal jahannum ki taraf jama kiye jayen gay. O hi badtar makan walay aur gumrah tar raastay walay hain
Aur bila-shuba hum ney Musa ko kitab di aur unn kay humrah unn kay bhai Haroon ko unn ka wazir banadiya
Aur keh diya kay tum dono unn logon ki taraf jao jo humari aayaton ko jhutla rahey hain. Phir hum ney unhen bilkul hi paamaal kerdiya
Aur qom Nooh ney bhi jab rasoolon ko jhoota kaha to hum ney unhen gharq kerdiya aur logon kay liye unhen nishan ibrat bana diya. Aur hum ney zalimon kay liye dard-naak azab mohiyya ker rakha hai
Aur aadiyon aur samoodiyon aur koowen walon ko aur unn kay darmiyan ki boht si ummaton ko (halak kerdiya)
Aur hum ney unn kay samney misalen biyan kin phir her aik ko bilkul hi tabah o barbaad kerdiya
Yeh log uss basti kay pass say bhi aatay jatay hain jin per buri tarah ki barish barsaee gaee. Kiya yeh phir bhi ussay dekhtay nahi? Haqeeqat yeh hai kay unhen mar ker ji uthney ki umeed hi nahi
Aur tumhen jab kabhi dekhtay hain to tum say maskhara pann kerney lagtay hain. Kay kiya yehi woh shakhs hain jinhen Allah Taalaa ney rasool bana ker bheja hai

(woh to kahiye) kay hum uss per jamay rahey werna unhon ney to humen humaray maboodon say behka mein koi kasar nahi chori thi. Aur yeh jab azabon ko dekhen gay to unhen saaf maloom hojaye ga kay poori tarah raah say bhatka hua kaun tha?
Kiya aap ney ussay bhi dekha jo apni khuwahish nafs ko apna mabood banaye huye hai kiya aap uss kay zimeydaar hosaktay hain?
Kiya aap ussi khayal mein hain kay unn mein say aksar suntay ya samajhtay hain. Woh to niray chopayon jaisay hain balkay)yeh unn say bhi ziyadah bhatkay huye
Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay aap kay rab ney saye ko kiss tarah phela diya hai? Agar chahata to ussay thehra hua hi ker deta. Phir hum ney aftab ko uss per daleel banaya
Phir hum ney ussay aahista aahista apni taraf khench liya
Aur o hi hai jiss ney raat ko tumharay liye pardah banaya. Aur neend ko rahat banaee. Aur din ko uth kharay honey ka waqt
Aur o hi hai jo baraan rehmat say pehlay khush khabri denay wali hawaon ko bhejta hai aur hum aasman say pak pani barsatay hain
Takay uss kay zariye say murdah shehar ko zindah ker den aur ussay hum apni makhlooqaat mein say boht say chopayon aur insano ko pilatay hain
Aur bey shak hum ney ussay unn kay darmiyan tarah tarah say biyan kiya takay woh naseehat hasil keren, magar phir bhi aksar logon ney siwaye na-shukri kay mana nahi
Agar hum chahatay to her her basti mein aik aik daraney wala bhej detay
Pus aap kafiron ka kehna na manen aur Quran kay zariye unn say poori taqat say bara jihad keren
Aur o hi hai jiss ney do samandar aapas mein mila rakhay hain, yeh hai meetha aur mazedaar aur yeh hai khaari kerwa, aur unn dono kay darmiyan aik hijab aur mazboot oat kerdi
Woh hai jiss ney pani say insan ko peda kiya, phir ussay nasab wala aur susrali rishton wala kerdiya. Bila-shuba aap ka perwerdigar (her cheez per) qadir hai
Yeh Allah ko chor ker unn ki ibadat kertay hain jo na to unhen koi nafa dey saken na koi nuksan phonca, aur kafir to hai hi apney rab kay khilaf (shetan ki) madad kerney wala
Hum ney to aap ko khushkhabri aur darr sunaney wala (nabi) bana ker bheja hai
Keh dijiye kay mein Quran kay phonchaney per tum say koi badla nahi chahata magar jo shakhs apney rab ki taraf raah pakarna chahaye
Uss hamesha zindah rehney walay Allah Taalaa per tawakkal keren jissay kabhi maut nahi aur uss ki tareef kay sath pakeezgi biyan kertay rahen, woh apney bandon kay gunahon say kafi khabardaar hai

O hi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zamin aur unn kay darmiyan ki sab cheezon ko chhe din mein peda kerdiya hai, phir arsh per mustawi hua, woh rehman hai, aap uss kay baray mein kissi khabardaar say pooch len

Unn say jab bhi kaha jata hai kay rehman ko sajdah kero to jawab detay hain rehman hai kiya? Kiya hum ussay sajdah keren jiss ka to humen hukum dey raha hai aur uss (tableegh) unn ki nafrat mein mazeed izafa kerdiya
Ba-barkat hai woh jiss ney aasman mein burj banaye aur uss mein aftab banaya aur munawar mahtab bhi
Aur ussi ney raat aur din ko aik doosray kay peechay aaney janey wala banaya. Uss shakhs ki naseehat kay liye jo naseehat hasil kerney ya shukar guzari kerney ka iradah rakhta ho
Rehman kay (sachay) banday woh hain jo zamin per farotni kay sath chaltay hain aur jab bey ilm log unn say baaten kerney lagtay hain to woh keh detay hain kay salam hai
Aur jo apney rab kay samney sajday aur qayam kertay huye raten guzaar detay hain
Aur jo yeh dua kertay hain kay aey humaray perwerdigar! hum say dozakh ka azab paray hi paray rakh, kyunkay uss ka azab chimat janey wala hai
Bey shak woh therney aur rehney kay lehaz say bad-tareen jagah hai
Aur jo kharach kertay waqt bhi na to israaf kertay hain na bakheeli, balkay)yeh unn dono kay darmiyan motadil tareeqay per kharach kertay hain

Aur Allah kay sath kissi doosray mabood ko nahi pukartay aur kissi aisay shakhs ko jissay qatal kerna Allah Taalaa ney mana kerdiya ho woh ba-juz haq kay qatal nahi kertay, na woh zinna kay murtakib hotay hain aur jo koi yeh kaam keray woh apney upper sakht wabaal laye ga
Ussay qayamat kay din dohra azab kiya jaye ga aur woh zillat o khuwari kay sath hamesha ussi mein rahey ga
Siwaye unn logon kay jo tauba keren aur eman layen aur nek kaam keren, aisay logon kay gunahon ko Allah Taalaa nekiyon say badal deta hai, Allah bakhshney wala meharbani kerney wala hai
Aur jo shakhs tauba keray aur nek amal keray woh to (haqeeqatan) Allah Taalaa ki taraf sacha rujoo kerta hai
Aur jo log jhooti gawahi nahi detay aur jab kissi laghaw cheez per unn ka guzar hota hai to sharafat say guzar jatay hain
Aur jab unhen unn kay rab kay kalaam ki aayaten sunaee jati hain to woh andhay behray ho ker unn per nahi girtay.
Aur yeh dua kertay hain kay aey humaray perwerdigar! to humen humari biwiyon aur aulad say aankhon ki thandak ata farma aur humen perhezgaron ka paishwa bana
Yehi woh log hain jinhen unn kay sabar kay badlay jannat kay buland o bala khaney diye jayen gay jahan unhen dua salam phonchaya jaye ga
Uss mein yeh hamesha rahen gay, woh boht hi achi jagah aur umdah muqam hai
Keh dijiye! agar tumhari dua iltija (pukarna) na hoti to mera rab tumhari mutlaq perwa na kerta, tum to jhutla chukay abb unqareeb uss ki saza tumhen chimat janey wali hogi
